name: Totten Glacier
description_en: East Antarctica's fastest-thinning glacier. Warm ocean water reaches through deep channels beneath the ice, melting it from below. The Aurora Subglacial Basin behind it holds enormous ice reserves.
description_zh: 东南极减薄最快的冰川。暖洋流通过冰下深水道到达底部进行融化。其后方的奥罗拉冰下盆地蕴藏着巨大的冰储量。

key_facts_en: Drains the Aurora Subglacial Basin — ~3.5 m of potential sea level rise
Warm Circumpolar Deep Water reaches the grounding line through deep channels
Significant subglacial water activity detected beneath the glacier
key_facts_zh: 排泄奥罗拉冰下盆地——约3.5米潜在海平面上升
暖环极深层水通过深水道到达接地线
冰川下方探测到显著的冰下水活动
